record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: Are the cosmological solutions in M-theory that are associated with a BPS state stable under the inhomogeneous perturbations required by such solutions, and how does that stability affect their possible role in the ambient cosmological construction?

evidence.quote:
2.5 Asymptotics of M-theory cosmology II
This is an extension of the previous problem in a diﬀerent direction. The plan is to examine the stability of those cosmological solutions that are associated with a BPS state cf. [50]. This requires the solutions to be inhomogeneous, and so may also have a signiﬁcant role to play in the ambient cosmological construction.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider eleven-dimensional supergravity (the low-energy limit of M-theory) and its time-dependent (cosmological) solutions of the equations of motion that are associated with a BPS state, i.e. solutions preserving a fraction of the supersymmetry of the underlying theory. Such cosmological backgrounds are generically required to be spatially inhomogeneous in order to be compatible with the BPS condition.

Determine whether these BPS-associated cosmological solutions of M-theory are stable under the inhomogeneous metric and matter perturbations that are intrinsically required by the BPS structure of the solutions. More precisely:

(a) Formulate a precise notion of linear (and, where possible, nonlinear) stability for a BPS cosmological background of eleven-dimensional supergravity under inhomogeneous perturbations consistent with the BPS data.

(b) For each such BPS cosmological solution, decide whether it is stable, marginally stable, or unstable in the sense of (a).

(c) Analyze how the resulting stability or instability constrains the role that such BPS cosmological solutions can play as building blocks of a larger (ambient) cosmological construction, e.g. as asymptotic regimes or as components glued into a global cosmological spacetime.
artifact.status_search_result: No specific subsequent work was located that conclusively settles the stability of BPS-associated inhomogeneous cosmological solutions of M-theory in full generality. Partial results exist on stability of particular supersymmetric/BPS backgrounds and of M-theory cosmologies in special limits, but a general resolution does not appear to be in the literature, so the status is taken as unknown.
